context.target_user: Content editors, compliance reviewers, and marketing managers
context.problem: Verifying cross-channel derivatives against canonical source text to prevent accidental distortion of insurance, pricing, or regulatory disclaimers.
context.use_case: Side-by-side text comparison before publishing derivative marketing copy.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 09, Diffchecker instantly exposed a critical insurance claim error introduced during manual copying into a draft email. Conditioned on manual copy-pasting of text snippets.
when_to_consider: Before publishing repurposed marketing snippets derived from sensitive legal or clinical guides.
When auditing revisions between original and updated service pages.
when_not_to_use: When expecting automated CMS synchronization (it is a standalone comparison utility).
